newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Piltel first qtr net slumps.
newsitem.headline: Piltel first qtr net slumps.

text.p: Cellular phone company Pilipino Telephone Corp (Piltel) said on Thursday it posted net income for the first quarter of 1997 at 42.6 million pesos from 246.6 million the same period last year.
Based on the company's unaudited income statement, Piltel's operating revenues rose to 1.22 billion pesos in the first quarter of the year from 1.16 billion in 1996.
But its operating expenses soared to 1.06 billion pesos from 792.6 million.
Provision for doubtful accounts of the mobile phone firm climbed to 122.3 million pesos from 22.6 million in the first three months of 1996.
Piltel, the country's biggest cellular phone firm, has been hit by rampant cloning and bad debts. At present, it has 360,000 subscribers.
